units.source_text: 二月十四日是赶鸟节［日本农村每年农历二月十四夜到十五日晨举行祭典，祷告丰收］。

en.t: February 14 is the bird-chasing festival, a rite held in Japanese farming villages from the night of the fourteenth day of the second lunar month until the morning of the fifteenth to pray for a good harvest.

units.source_text: 这是雪国的孩子们每年照例举行的节日。

en.t: It is an annual festival that the children of the snow country hold as a matter of custom.

units.source_text: 十天以前，村里的孩子们就穿上草鞋［原文藁沓，一种雪地用的草鞋］把积雪踩实，

en.t: About ten days beforehand, the village children put on straw snow sandals and trample the accumulated snow firm,

units.source_text: 然后切成约莫两尺见方的雪板，并把它们垒成一间殿堂，

en.t: then cut it into snow slabs about two feet square and pile them up into a little shrine hall,

units.source_text: 大小丈八见方，足有一丈多高。

en.t: it is about eighteen feet square and fully more than ten feet high.

units.source_text: 十四日晚上，把家家户户的稻草绳［日本风俗，在新年挂在门前的一种稻草绳，取意吉利］收集起来，

en.t: On the night of the fourteenth, they gather the straw ropes hung at each house for the New Year as lucky decorations,

units.source_text: 堆在殿堂前熊熊地焚烧起来。

en.t: and heap them before the shrine hall, where they burn them in a bright blazing fire.
